title: Bhima and Bakasura
style_lock: Premium high-quality charming painted comic / Amar Chitra mythology; warm cream-saffron-gold hour; refined linework
frame: Ornate lotus carved wooden frame on every plate

bhima.face: Young adult warrior, broad jaw, dark eyes, thick dark mustache, confident calm
bhima.costume: Saffron-yellow dhoti with gold border, powerful bare chest, armbands

bakasura.face: Stylized rakshasa, fierce comic mythology not gore

plates.beat_text: In the town of Ekachakra the Pandavas live in secret — and a shadow hangs over every home.
must_show: Premium high-quality painted comic Amar Chitra village at golden hour
Quiet Indian town Ekachakra with thatched and tiled homes, peepal, distant hills
Subtle sense of unease — empty street or worried townsfolk at doorways
plates.prompt: Premium high-quality painted comic Amar Chitra mythology. Wide establishing view of the ancient Indian town of Ekachakra at cream-saffron golden hour. Thatched and low brick houses, peepal tree, distant forest hills. A few worried townsfolk at doorways — equal natural scale. Soft shadow of fear over a peaceful town. Ornate lotus wooden frame. Refined linework matching Ep01 gold master, not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: Bakasura, a terrible rakshasa, demands a cart of food and one human life each day.
must_show: Towering stylized rakshasa Bakasura in forest clearing — fierce but not gory photoreal horror
Sense of demand and menace, empty food cart nearby optional
plates.prompt: Premium high-quality painted comic Amar Chitra. Giant stylized rakshasa Bakasura stands in a golden-hour forest clearing — large, fierce, comic-mythology design not photoreal horror or gore. Dark green-brown cloth, wild hair. Menace and power. Ornate lotus frame, cream-saffron light. Match Ep01 gold master style.

plates.beat_text: When the lot falls on a brahmin household, grief fills the cottage.
must_show: Brahmin family in a simple cottage interior, grief and fear
Warm lamp light, equal scale, dignified sorrow not melodrama
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Simple brahmin cottage interior at evening. Father in white, mother and children grieving — dignified sorrow when the lot falls to them. Warm cream-gold lamp light. Equal natural scale. Ornate lotus frame, refined quality, not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: Kunti hears their sorrow. She sends her son Bhima in their place.
must_show: Mother Kunti in saffron/cream sari speaking with resolve
Bhima beside her — large powerful young warrior, saffron-yellow dhoti, thick mustache, topknot, calm strength
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Mother Kunti in cream-saffron sari places a hand of blessing or resolve. Beside her stands Bhima: largest young Pandava warrior, broad shoulders, thick dark mustache, black topknot, saffron-yellow dhoti with gold border, calm noble strength. Cottage interior, warm light. Ornate lotus frame. Refined quality, not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: Bhima drives the food cart toward the forest, calm as a mountain on the move.
must_show: Bhima driving or walking with a wooden cart loaded with food pots toward forest path
Same Bhima face and build as kunti plate
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Powerful Bhima in saffron-yellow dhoti, thick mustache, topknot, drives a wooden ox-cart or pulls a cart stacked with food pots and vessels along a golden-hour path toward dark forest. Calm mountain strength. Ornate lotus frame. Same character design, refined quality, not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: He sits and eats every last morsel — then waits for the monster who would claim him.
must_show: Bhima seated among empty pots and trays, having finished the feast, waiting calmly
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Bhima sits in a forest clearing among emptied clay pots and food trays, last of the feast done, relaxed powerful posture waiting. Saffron-yellow dhoti, thick mustache, topknot. Golden hour. Ornate lotus frame. Refined charming style, not photoreal, not gross.

plates.beat_text: Bakasura comes roaring. Bhima meets him with bare hands and a warrior’s joy.
must_show: Dynamic clash: Bhima grappling or striking Bakasura
Both full figures, equal comic mythology style, Bakasura larger but not photoreal monster CGI
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra action plate. Bhima (saffron dhoti, thick mustache, topknot, powerful build) clashes bare-handed with towering stylized rakshasa Bakasura in a forest clearing. Dramatic dynamic poses, warrior energy. Stylized not gory — no heavy blood or photoreal horror. Ornate lotus frame, cream-saffron-gold light, refined quality.

plates.beat_text: The fight ends. Bakasura falls. Ekachakra will fear him no more.
must_show: Bhima standing composed and victorious; Bakasura defeated on the ground (tasteful, not gory)
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Bhima stands composed and princely after victory — calm strength, saffron dhoti, mustache, topknot. Stylized Bakasura defeated on the ground (tasteful collapse, no gore). Forest clearing golden light. Ornate lotus frame. Refined quality, not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: So Bhima kept the vow of the strong: protect those who cannot protect themselves.
must_show: Premium quality gold closing mood like Ep01 wide-gold
Bhima returning or standing before grateful townsfolk of Ekachakra
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra closing plate. Warm cream-saffron-gold hour like Ep01 plate-wide-gold. Bhima (powerful, saffron dhoti, mustache) walks or stands as grateful Ekachakra townsfolk bow in relief. Peace after terror. Ornate lotus frame. Refined charming quality, not photoreal.
